exercises.answer: If you hurry, you will not be late.
exercises.explain: 将从句和主句都改为肯定形式。

exercises.q: You will feel better if you take this medicine. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will I feel better if I take this medicine?
exercises.explain: 将主句改为一般疑问句，if从句保持不变。

exercises.q: If you are hungry, eat something. (用you will改写)
exercises.answer: If you are hungry, you will eat something.
exercises.explain: 将祈使句主句改为将来时陈述句。

exercises.q: If you will come to my house, I will show you my new bike.
exercises.answer: If you come to my house, I will show you my new bike.
exercises.explain: if从句中应使用一般现在时come，而非will come。

exercises.q: She will call you if she will arrive early.
exercises.answer: She will call you if she arrives early.
exercises.explain: if从句中应用一般现在时arrives。

exercises.q: If you ______ the instructions carefully, you won't make mistakes.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时表示条件。

exercises.q: We can finish the project on time if everyone ______ their part.
exercises.explain: 条件从句用一般现在时，everyone为单数。

exercises.q: If the weather ______ nice this weekend, we will go hiking.
exercises.explain: if从句中用一般现在时表示将来可能的情况。

exercises.q: You should see a doctor if you ______ sick.
exercises.explain: 主句有情态动词should，if从句仍用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If Tom doesn't apologize, I ______ to him again.
exercises.explain: 主句用将来时否定形式，表示可能的结果。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not water) the plants, they will die.
exercises.explain: if从句否定用don't+动词原形。

exercises.q: We will go to the beach if the sun ______ (shine) tomorrow.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时，主语the sun为第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If she ______ (practice) every day, she will improve quickly.
exercises.explain: 条件从句用一般现在时，主语she为第三人称单数。

exercises.q: If you will be late, please call me.
exercises.explain: if从句中不能用will be，应改为are。

exercises.q: You can borrow my book if you return it by Friday.
exercises.explain: 主句用情态动词can，if从句用一般现在时，结构正确。

exercises.q: If you don't leave now, you will miss the train. (用unless改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you leave now, you will miss the train.
exercises.explain: unless相当于if...not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If you heat ice, it melts. (改为第一类条件句，表示将来可能)
exercises.answer: If you heat the ice, it will melt.
exercises.explain: 将零条件句改为第一类条件句，主句加will。

exercises.q: You will succeed if you try your best. (将if从句置于句首)
exercises.answer: If you try your best, you will succeed.
exercises.explain: if从句提前时，主从句之间用逗号隔开。

exercises.q: If the bus will come late, we will wait at the station.
exercises.answer: If the bus comes late, we will wait at the station.
exercises.explain: if从句中应用一般现在时comes。

exercises.q: You won't pass the test if you won't study.
exercises.answer: You won't pass the test if you don't study.
exercises.explain: if从句否定用don't study，而非won't study。

exercises.q: If the company ______ the new policy, many employees will benefit from it.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时，主语the company为单数。

exercises.q: You ______ able to finish the task on time if you manage your schedule well.
exercises.explain: 主句用will be able to表示将来的能力。

exercises.q: If he ______ more careful, he might avoid making such mistakes.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时，主句用情态动词might表示可能性。

exercises.q: If you have any questions, ______ to ask the teacher.
exercises.explain: 主句为祈使句否定形式，用don't+动词原形。

exercises.q: The project will be delayed if the funding ______ approved in time.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时被动语态表示条件。

exercises.q: If the experiment ______ (succeed), the scientists will publish their findings.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时，主语the experiment为单数。

exercises.q: You should inform the manager if you ______ (decide) to change the plan.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时，主句有情态动词should。

exercises.q: If the weather conditions ______ (be) favorable, the launch will proceed as scheduled.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时，主语conditions为复数。

exercises.q: If the data will be analyzed carefully, the results will be reliable.
exercises.explain: if从句中不能用will be，应改为is analyzed。

exercises.q: If you had told me earlier, I would have helped you.
exercises.explain: 这是第三类条件句，不是第一类条件句。

exercises.q: If you don't follow the instructions, the machine won't work properly. (用unless改写)
exercises.answer: Unless you follow the instructions, the machine won't work properly.
exercises.explain: unless相当于if...not，后接肯定形式。

exercises.q: If you practice regularly, you can improve your speaking skills. (用be able to改写)
exercises.answer: If you practice regularly, you will be able to improve your speaking skills.
exercises.explain: 将can改为will be able to，表示将来的能力。

exercises.q: The event will be canceled if it rains heavily. (将if从句置于句首)
exercises.answer: If it rains heavily, the event will be canceled.
exercises.explain: if从句提前时，主从句之间用逗号隔开。

exercises.q: If the committee will approve the budget, the project can start next month.
exercises.answer: If the committee approves the budget, the project can start next month.
exercises.explain: if从句中应用一般现在时approves。

exercises.q: You might not get the scholarship if you won't submit the application on time.
exercises.answer: You might not get the scholarship if you don't submit the application on time.
exercises.explain: if从句否定用don't submit，而非won't submit。

exercises.q: If it ______ tomorrow, we will stay at home.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句中，if从句用一般现在时表将来，不能用will。

exercises.q: You ______ the exam if you study hard.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句主句常用一般将来时will+动词原形。

exercises.q: If she ______ late again, the teacher will be angry.
exercises.explain: if引导的条件状语从句用一般现在时表示将来条件。

exercises.q: ______ you feel tired, you can take a break.
exercises.explain: If引导条件状语从句，表示“如果”。

exercises.q: If you ______ to the party, you will meet many new friends.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句if从句用一般现在时，主句用will。

exercises.q: If he ______ (come) tomorrow, I will call you.
exercises.explain: if从句用一般现在时，主语he为第三人称单数，动词加s。

exercises.q: We will go for a picnic if the weather ______ (be) nice.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句if从句用一般现在时。

exercises.q: If you ______ (not hurry), you will miss the bus.
exercises.explain: if从句否定形式用don't+动词原形。

exercises.q: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the trip.
exercises.explain: if从句中不能用will，应改为rains。

exercises.q: If you heat ice, it melts.
exercises.explain: 这是零条件句表示科学事实，但结构上if从句用一般现在时是正确的。

exercises.q: If you study hard, you will pass the exam. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: If you don't study hard, you won't pass the exam.
exercises.explain: 否定句在if从句和主句分别加don't和won't。

exercises.q: You will be late if you don't leave now. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Will you be late if you don't leave now?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将主句的will提到主语前。

exercises.q: If you feel tired, you can rest. (用should改写)
exercises.answer: If you feel tired, you should rest.
exercises.explain: 第一类条件句主句可用情态动词should表示建议。

exercises.q: If you will need help, please call me.
exercises.answer: If you need help, please call me.
exercises.explain: if从句中不能用will，应改为一般现在时need。

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词 'can' 表能力/可能性
grammar.title: 情态动词 can 表能力与可能性（拓展：could / be able to / may / might）
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability and Possibility (Extended: could / be able to / may / might)
grammar.usage:
情态动词 can 在高中阶段主要承担两大语义功能：一是表示“能力”，即主语具备做某事的能力或条件；二是表示“可能性”，即说话人认为某事在客观上有可能发生或成立。其核心结构为“主语 + can + 动词原形”，无人称和数的变化。否定形式为 cannot（正式）或 can't（口语/非正式），疑问形式将 can 提前至主语之前。

在表示“能力”时，初中阶段通常只要求掌握 can 表示“会做某事”的基本用法，如 I can swim. 高中阶段则需要进一步区分 can 与 be able to：can 倾向于表示一般性、与生俱来或长期具备的能力，而 be able to 更强调在特定情境下通过努力或克服困难后“设法做成某事”，且 be able to 可以用于各种时态，弥补 can 没有将来时和完成时的缺陷。

在表示“可能性”时，can 常用于肯定句中表示“理论上的可能”或“有时会出现的可能”，如 Learning a language can be challenging. 但在肯定句中表示“具体某事可能发生”时，高中英语更倾向于使用 may / might / could，而 can 在肯定句中的可能性用法多带有“一般性、规律性”色彩。在否定句和疑问句中，can 表示“不可能”或“难道会……吗”，如 It can't be true. / Can it be true?

can 的过去式 could 在高中阶段有双重身份：一是作为 can 的过去式，表示过去的能力或可能性；二是作为独立的情态动词，用于现在或将来语境中表示更委婉的语气或更小的可能性。例如 Could you help me? 比 Can you help me? 更委婉；It could rain later. 表示的可能性比 It may rain later. 更不确定。

易错点方面：第一，can 后必须接动词原形，不能加 to，也不能用 can to do；第二，can 没有人称和数的变化，不存在 he cans 或 she can 加 s 的形式；第三，can 没有不定式、分词和将来时形式，需要表达将来能力时要用 will be able to；第四，在肯定句中表示“某事具体可能发生”时，不宜滥用 can，而应根据语境选择 may / might / could，这是高考书面表达中语域准确性的重要体现。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + can + 动词原形
否定式：主语 + cannot / can't + 动词原形
疑问式：Can + 主语 + 动词原形 + ...?
过去式：主语 + could + 动词原形（表过去能力或委婉语气）
替代结构：主语 + be able to + 动词原形（可用于各种时态）
可能性对比：can（理论/一般可能）vs may / might / could（具体可能，语气递减）
notes: can 后必须接动词原形，写作 can to do 或 can doing 均为典型错误，高考语法填空和短文改错中高频出现。
can 没有第三人称单数形式，he cans / she can 加 s 是初中遗留的顽固错误，高中写作中要彻底杜绝。
can 不能用于将来时和完成时，表达“将来能够”要用 will be able to，表达“已经能够”要用 have been able to。
在肯定句中表示“某件具体事情可能发生”时，书面语中优先用 may / might / could，can 更多用于否定句和疑问句表示“不可能”或“难道会……吗”。
could 在高中阶段不仅是 can 的过去式，还常用于现在语境表示委婉请求或更小的可能性，需根据上下文判断其真实时间指向。

examples.en: I can ride a bike, but I can't drive a car.
examples.cn: 我会骑自行车，但不会开汽车。

examples.en: Can your brother play the piano?
examples.cn: 你哥哥会弹钢琴吗？

examples.en: She could read when she was only four years old.
examples.cn: 她四岁时就能阅读了。

examples.en: With enough practice, you will be able to speak English fluently.
examples.cn: 经过足够的练习，你将能够流利地说英语。

examples.en: It can't be him—he left for Beijing this morning.
examples.cn: 不可能是他——他今天早上已经去北京了。

examples.en: The data might suggest a different conclusion, but further analysis could reveal other possibilities.
examples.cn: 数据可能暗示了不同的结论，但进一步分析或许会揭示其他可能性。

exercises.q: My little brother ______ ride a bike now.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 后接动词原形，且没有人称变化。

exercises.q: ______ you help me with my homework, please?
exercises.explain: 表示请求许可时用 Can 开头构成疑问句。

exercises.q: Fish ______ live without water.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 can't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: A dog ______ be a good friend to you.
exercises.explain: can 表示可能性，后接动词原形 be。

exercises.q: I ______ swim very fast when I was young.
exercises.explain: 表示过去的能力用 could，是 can 的过去式。

exercises.q: Birds ______ fly in the sky.
exercises.explain: 表示能力用 can，后接动词原形 fly。

exercises.q: ______ I open the window? It's hot here.
exercises.explain: 请求许可时用 Can 开头，注意句首大写。

exercises.q: He ______ speak English, but he can speak Chinese.
exercises.explain: 根据 but 转折可知前句表示否定，用 can't。

exercises.q: She cans play the piano very well.
exercises.explain: can 是情态动词，没有人称变化，不能加 s。

exercises.q: My father can to cook delicious food.
exercises.explain: can 后直接跟动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.q: I can play basketball. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 can't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: She can dance well. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 can 提到主语前。

exercises.q: They can be good friends. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: can 表可能性时否定形式仍为 can't。

exercises.q: He cans run very fast.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 没有人称变化，应去掉 s。

exercises.q: We can to go to the park tomorrow.
exercises.answer: We can go to the park tomorrow.
exercises.explain: can 后直接跟动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.q: When I was five, I ______ read simple stories.
exercises.explain: 表示过去的能力用 could，与时间状语 when I was five 一致。

exercises.q: You ______ be right, but I'm not sure.
exercises.explain: may 表示不确定的可能性，与 but I'm not sure 呼应。

exercises.q: ______ you please pass me the salt?
exercises.explain: Could you please 是更委婉的请求表达。

exercises.q: My sister ______ speak three languages when she was ten.
exercises.explain: 过去的能力用 could，be able to 虽然也可表能力但时态需为 was able to。

exercises.q: It ______ be very cold in winter in Harbin.
exercises.explain: can 表示客观可能性，说明哈尔滨冬天可能很冷。

exercises.q: After years of practice, she is ______ to swim across the river.
exercises.explain: be able to 强调通过努力获得的能力，此处用 able。

exercises.q: ______ I use your phone? I need to call my mom.
exercises.explain: May I 是更正式的请求许可表达。

exercises.q: He ______ be at home now, but I'm not sure.
exercises.explain: may 表示不确定的推测，与 not sure 呼应。

exercises.q: Could you please open the door? 这句话中 could 表示过去的能力。
exercises.explain: 此处 could 表示委婉的请求，而非过去的能力。

exercises.q: be able to 可以用于各种时态，而 can 只有现在式和过去式。
exercises.explain: be able to 可与时态灵活搭配，can 只有现在式 can 和过去式 could。

exercises.q: She could play the violin at the age of six. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: She was able to play the violin at the age of six.
exercises.explain: 过去的能力可用 was/were able to 替换 could。

exercises.q: You can't smoke here. (改为委婉的请求或建议)
exercises.answer: Could you please not smoke here?
exercises.explain: 用 Could you please not 使否定请求更委婉。

exercises.q: It is possible for them to be relatives. (用 can 改写)
exercises.explain: can 可表示可能性，替代 It is possible for...to... 结构。

exercises.q: She can sings very well.
exercises.explain: can 后必须接动词原形，不能用第三人称单数形式。

exercises.q: Do you can help me with this box?
exercises.answer: Can you help me with this box?
exercises.explain: can 作情态动词构成疑问句时直接提前，不需要助动词 do。

exercises.q: By the time she was seven, she ______ already read simple novels.
exercises.explain: 过去的能力用 could，与时间状语 by the time she was seven 一致。

exercises.q: He ______ have finished the work, but I'm not entirely sure.
exercises.explain: may have done 表示对过去事情的不确定推测。

exercises.q: ______ you mind if I open the window?
exercises.explain: Would you mind if... 是固定句型，表示委婉请求许可。

exercises.q: The news ______ be true, but we need to check it carefully.
exercises.explain: might 表示较小的可能性，与后文需要核实呼应。

exercises.q: I ______ speak French fluently after living in Paris for three years.
exercises.explain: 强调经过努力后获得的能力，用 was able to 更准确。

exercises.q: She ______ have gone to the library, but nobody saw her there.
exercises.explain: might have done 表示对过去事情的可能性推测，且可能性较小。

exercises.q: If you practice more, you will be ______ to pass the driving test.
exercises.explain: be able to 表示将来经过努力获得的能力。

exercises.q: The boy ______ not have stolen the money; he was at home all day.
exercises.explain: could not have done 表示对过去事情的否定推测。

exercises.q: 在正式书面语中，may 比 can 更常用于表示许可。
exercises.explain: may 在正式语境中表示许可更得体，can 偏口语化。

exercises.q: could have done 只能表示过去有能力做但没做。
exercises.explain: could have done 还可表示对过去事情的推测，含义更丰富。

exercises.q: It is possible that they are close friends. (用 can 改写)
exercises.explain: can 可表示可能性，替代 It is possible that... 结构。

exercises.q: I was able to solve the problem after thinking for an hour. (用 could 改写)
exercises.answer: I could solve the problem after thinking for an hour.
exercises.explain: 在肯定句中 could 可替代 was able to 表示过去的能力。

exercises.q: You must not park here. (改为更委婉的禁止表达)
exercises.explain: can't 表示禁止时语气比 must not 稍委婉。

exercises.q: He may can come to the party tonight.
exercises.answer: He may come to the party tonight.
exercises.explain: 情态动词不能连用，may 和 can 只能保留一个。

exercises.q: She could able to speak three languages when she was young.
exercises.answer: She could speak three languages when she was young.
exercises.explain: could 和 able to 不能同时使用，应去掉 able to。

exercises.q: My little brother ______ ride a bike now, but last year he couldn't.
exercises.explain: now 提示现在的能力，用 can 后接动词原形。

exercises.q: ______ you help me carry this heavy box, please?
exercises.explain: 请求许可用 Can you...，情态动词 can 提前构成疑问句。

exercises.q: A close friend ______ be someone you trust completely.
exercises.explain: can 表示可能性，后接动词原形 be。

exercises.q: I'm sorry, but I ______ come to your party tomorrow.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式是 can't 或 cannot，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: Birds ______ fly, but fish cannot.
exercises.explain: 表示动物的自然能力，用 can 加动词原形。

exercises.q: My grandmother is eighty, but she ______ still cook very well.
exercises.explain: 表示现在仍具备的能力，情态动词 can 后接动词原形。

exercises.q: ______ your parents speak English?
exercises.explain: 疑问句将 can 置于主语之前。

exercises.q: We ______ not go out because it is raining heavily.
exercises.explain: cannot 表示因客观条件不允许，can 后接 not 构成否定。

exercises.q: He cans play the guitar very well.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 没有人称和数的变化，不能加 -s。

exercises.q: Can you to open the window?
exercises.explain: can 后必须接动词原形，不能加 to。

exercises.q: I can swim across the river. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: I cannot/can't swim across the river.
exercises.explain: can 的否定形式为 cannot 或 can't，后接动词原形。

exercises.q: She can play the piano. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 can 提到主语之前。

exercises.q: They can be good friends. (改为否定句)
exercises.explain: 否定句在 can 后加 not。

exercises.q: My father can to drive a car.
exercises.answer: My father can drive a car.
exercises.explain: can 后应接动词原形，去掉 to。

exercises.q: She cans speak three languages.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 can 没有人称变化，不能加 -s。

exercises.q: When I was young, I ______ run very fast, but now I can't.
exercises.explain: when I was young 提示过去的能力，用 can 的过去式 could。

exercises.q: You ______ be right, but I need more evidence to believe it.
exercises.explain: could 在此表示较弱的可能性，意为“有可能”。

exercises.q: After months of practice, she ______ play the violin beautifully now.
exercises.explain: be able to 强调通过努力获得的能力，且可用于现在时。

exercises.q: ______ I use your phone? Mine is out of battery.
exercises.explain: May I... 表示更正式的请求许可，比 Can I 更委婉。

exercises.q: He ______ be at home now because the lights are on.
exercises.explain: must 表示很有把握的肯定推测，意为“一定”。

exercises.q: She ______ not have finished the work yet; it's too difficult.
exercises.explain: could not have done 表示对过去情况的否定推测。

exercises.q: If you try harder, you ______ achieve your goal.
exercises.explain: 条件句中用 can 表示将来可能实现的能力或结果。

exercises.q: He was so strong that he ______ lift the heavy stone easily.
exercises.explain: 过去的能力用 could 表示。

exercises.q: She could be a doctor, but she chose to be a teacher.
exercises.explain: could be 表示过去存在的可能性或潜在选择。

exercises.q: He can to speak French fluently when he was a child.
exercises.explain: can 后不能接 to，且过去能力应用 could。

exercises.q: She is able to solve the problem. (用 can 改写)
exercises.explain: be able to 与 can 在表示能力时可互换。

exercises.q: They could finish the project on time. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: They could not/couldn't finish the project on time.
exercises.explain: could 的否定形式为 could not 或 couldn't。

exercises.q: Can he be trusted? (改为陈述句)
exercises.explain: 疑问句还原为陈述句时，can 放回主语之后。

exercises.q: She could sings very well when she was five.
exercises.answer: She could sing very well when she was five.
exercises.explain: 情态动词 could 后接动词原形，不能用第三人称单数形式。

exercises.q: You mustn't be tired after such a long journey.
exercises.answer: You must be tired after such a long journey.

grammar.key: Imperative Sentences for Advice / 祈使句表建议
grammar.title: 祈使句表建议：从基本指令到委婉建议（含 please / never / 反问附加句）
grammar.titleEn: Imperative Sentences for Advice: From Basic Commands to Polite Suggestions
grammar.usage:
祈使句表建议时，核心结构是以动词原形开头，省略主语 you，直接向对方提出指令、请求、建议或邀请。肯定形式为“动词原形 + 其他成分”，否定形式为“Don't / Never + 动词原形 + 其他成分”。疑问形式通常不直接使用祈使句本身，而是借助附加疑问句（如 will you / won't you / can you）或将其转换为一般疑问句（如 Could you...?）来弱化命令语气。

与近义结构对比：祈使句表建议语气直接、简洁，适合面对面指导或书面建议；而“You should / ought to...”更侧重义务和道理，“Why don't you...?”更委婉、更口语化，“How about / What about + doing...?”则侧重提出一个具体方案。高中阶段需要根据语境和语域选择：正式书面建议多用祈使句或 should，日常口语中则更常用 Why don't you...? 或 How about...?。

初中用法主要停留在“肯定以动词原形开头、否定用 Don't”的机械操练，句子较短，常与 please 搭配。高中用法则要求理解祈使句在篇章中的功能——如作者连续使用多个祈使句构成“步骤式建议”，并能在写作中有意识地使用“祈使句 + 附加疑问句”“Never + 动词原形”等结构来调整语气。

易错点：1. 在祈使句开头误加主语 you 或误加 to，如“You try to know yourself”或“To try to know yourself”都不符合标准祈使句表建议的用法。2. 否定形式误用“Not + 动词原形”，正确应为“Don't / Never + 动词原形”。3. 把“Please + 动词原形”与“动词原形 + please”混用导致语感生硬，书面语中 please 置于句首更正式，置于句尾更口语化。4. 在正式书面语中过度使用“Let's...”来表建议，容易显得口语化或不够客观。
forms: 肯定：动词原形 + 其他成分（如：Try to know yourself.）
否定：Don't / Never + 动词原形 + 其他成分（如：Don't be afraid. / Never give up.）
礼貌：Please + 动词原形 + 其他成分 / 动词原形 + 其他成分, please.
强调：Do + 动词原形 + 其他成分（如：Do remember to bring your notebook.）
附加疑问：祈使句 + will you / won't you / can you?（如：Read the passage carefully, will you?）
Let 结构：Let + 宾语 + 动词原形（如：Let me give you a piece of advice.）
notes: 高考书面表达中，连续使用多个祈使句可形成“步骤式建议”，但需注意不要全部用同一句式，可穿插 should / It is advisable to... 等结构增加句式多样性。
Never 开头的祈使句语气比 Don't 更强，常用于正式建议或警示性书面语，如“Never ignore your mental health.”
祈使句 + will you? 语气较缓和，适合请求；祈使句 + won't you? 更委婉，带有邀请意味，如“Have a seat, won't you?”
在正式语域中，单纯用祈使句可能显得生硬，可改用“It is strongly recommended that...”“You are advised to...”等结构。
注意区分祈使句表建议与动词原形开头的其他结构：不定式作主语时句首是 to do，如“To know yourself is important.”，这不是祈使句。

grammar.key: Present Perfect Tense for Life Experience / 现在完成时表经历
grammar.title: 现在完成时表经历（含 since / for / 持续性动词与短暂性动词）
grammar.titleEn: Present Perfect Tense for Life Experience (with since / for / durative vs. momentary verbs)
grammar.usage:
现在完成时表经历，核心结构为“主语 + have/has + 过去分词”，表示从过去某一时间开始、持续到现在的动作或状态，或强调过去的经历对现在仍有影响。肯定句中，主语为第三人称单数时用 has，其余人称用 have；否定形式在 have/has 后加 not，常缩写为 haven’t / hasn’t；疑问句将 have/has 提前至主语之前。

与 since 连用时，since 后接过去时间点（如 2010、last year、birth）或一般过去时的从句，表示“自……以来一直……”。与 for 连用时，for 后接一段时间（如 ten years、a long time），表示动作或状态持续的长度。两者常与现在完成时搭配，但侧重点不同：since 强调起点，for 强调时长。

初中阶段主要要求掌握 have/has + 过去分词的基本形式，以及 since + 时间点、for + 时间段的简单搭配。高中阶段则需进一步区分持续性动词（如 live、know、work、study）与短暂性动词（如 come、go、buy、die、join、leave）。短暂性动词的现在完成时不能与 for / since 表示一段时间的状语连用，需转换为相应的持续性表达，例如 buy → have，come → be here，join → be in，die → be dead，leave → be away。

易错点一：since 后接从句时，从句谓语通常用一般过去时，而主句用现在完成时，不可在 since 从句中使用现在完成时。易错点二：短暂性动词的否定形式可以与 since / for 连用，表示“多久没有做某事”，如 I haven’t seen him for years. 是正确用法。易错点三：have been to 表示“去过某地（已回来）”，have gone to 表示“去了某地（尚未回来）”，两者含义不同，不可混用。易错点四：在书面语中，现在完成时与一般过去时不可随意替换：一般过去时只陈述过去事实，而现在完成时强调与现在的联系。
forms: 肯定式：主语 + have/has + 过去分词 + since + 过去时间点/一般过去时从句
否定式：主语 + haven’t/hasn’t + 过去分词 + for + 一段时间
疑问式：Have/Has + 主语 + 过去分词 + …?
短暂性动词转换：have bought → have had；have come → have been here；have joined → have been in
have been to + 地点（去过已回） vs. have gone to + 地点（去了未回）
It has been + 一段时间 + since + 一般过去时从句（高中书面语常见句型）
notes: since 引导时间状语从句时，从句用一般过去时，主句用现在完成时，高考书面表达中常在此处设错。
短暂性动词（come、go、buy、die、join、leave 等）的肯定式不能与 for / since 表示一段时间的状语连用，需转换为持续性表达。
短暂性动词的否定式可以与 since / for 连用，表示“多久没有……”，如 haven’t seen him for years，这是正确且地道的用法。
have been to 与 have gone to 在语域和语义上均有区别，高考完形和语法填空中常考二者的辨析。
在正式书面语中，It has been + 一段时间 + since 从句 比 It is + 一段时间 + since 从句 更正式，但两种结构均正确。

grammar.key: Passive Voice with 'As is known to all' / 被动语态 '众所周知'
grammar.title: 被动语态“众所周知”结构：As is known to all 及相关拓展（含 as is said / as was mentioned / as is reported 等）
grammar.titleEn: Passive Voice with “As is known to all” and Related Structures
grammar.usage:
本语法点围绕“As is known to all”这一被动结构展开，核心结构为：As + be + 过去分词 + (to/by...)，用于引出一个公认的事实、观点或信息。As 在这里是关系代词，指代后面整个主句的内容，整个 as 从句相当于一个插入性的评注性状语，常置于句首，也可置于句中或句末。

肯定形式中，be 动词根据时态变化，如 is/was/has been，后接过去分词 known、said、reported、believed、expected 等。否定形式通常将 not 放在 be 动词之后，如 As is not widely known；也可通过否定主句来表达相反含义，但需注意语义重心的不同。疑问形式较少用于该结构，因为“众所周知”本身是陈述性、评注性的表达；若需提问，一般改为 It is known that... 的疑问形式，如 Is it known to all that...?。

与近义结构对比：As everyone knows 是主动语态，语义相同但语体更口语化、主观化；It is known to all that... 是形式主语结构，语气更正式，但句子重心后移，不如 as 结构简洁；What is known to all is that... 是名词性从句作主语，强调“大家都知道的事情是……”，在书面语中更显复杂和正式。

初中阶段主要接触 As we all know 或 As everyone knows 这类主动表达，理解其“众所周知”的含义即可；高中阶段则要求掌握 As is known to all 这类被动评注性状语从句，并能在书面表达中替换主动形式，提升语体的正式度和客观性。同时还需拓展掌握 As is often said、As was mentioned earlier、As is reported in the newspaper、As is shown in the chart 等同类结构，以应对说明文、议论文和图表作文的写作需求。

易错点一：误把 as 当普通连词，在后面接完整句子，如 As it is known to all 是错误结构，因为 as 本身已充当从句主语，不可再加 it。易错点二：时态混用，主句是过去时，as 从句仍用 is，如 As is known to all, he won the prize last year 中，若强调“当时大家都知道”应改为 As was known to all。易错点三：把 known 写成 knowing，混淆主动和被动，known 是过去分词，表示“被知道”。易错点四：在书面表达中过度使用 As we all know，显得口语化且重复，高中写作应适当换用被动形式或 It is widely known that... 等结构。
forms: As + is/was + 过去分词 + (to all)，如 As is known to all, ...
As + is/was + 过去分词 + (by sb)，如 As is believed by many scientists, ...
As + has been + 过去分词，如 As has been reported, ...
As + is + 副词 + 过去分词，如 As is often said, ... / As is widely known, ...
As + was + 过去分词 + 时间状语，如 As was mentioned earlier, ...
It is + 过去分词 + to all + that...，如 It is known to all that...（形式主语变体）
notes: as 在从句中作主语，指代整个主句，后面不能再出现 it，如不能说 As it is known to all。
高考书面表达中，As we all know 可用但偏口语化，建议在议论文、说明文中换用 As is known to all 或 It is widely known that... 以提升语域。
注意时态呼应：主句为过去时或强调过去情况时，as 从句用 was/had been，如 As was known to all at that time, ...。
known 是过去分词，不可写成 knowing；该结构必须用被动形式，不能写成 As is knowing to all。
该结构常与图表作文、报告类写作搭配，如 As is shown in the chart, ... / As is reported in the survey, ...，注意不要与 As a result 等普通短语混淆。

grammar.titleEn: Emphatic Structure with “No one but...” and Related Patterns
grammar.usage:
“No one but...” 是一种表示“只有……才……”的强调结构，核心含义相当于 only 或 no one except。其基本结构为：No one but + 名词/代词 + 单数谓语动词。这里的 but 不是表示转折的连词，而是介词，意为“除了……之外”。整个短语在句中作主语时，谓语动词的数由 no one 决定，因此通常用单数形式。

肯定形式中，该结构直接表达“只有某人能做某事”或“只有某物具有某种性质”。否定形式一般通过谓语动词的否定来实现，例如 No one but him does not know the truth（除了他之外，没有人不知道真相），但这类双重否定在高中阶段更多出现在阅读和写作的修辞表达中。疑问形式较少直接使用 No one but... 开头，更常见的是将其置于宾语或表语位置，如 Is there no one but you who can solve this? 或 Who but you can define yourself?。

与近义结构相比，“No one but...” 比 only 更具书面语色彩和强调力度。only 可以直接修饰主语、谓语或状语，位置灵活；而 No one but... 更强调“排除其他一切可能性”。与 nothing but 相比，no one but 强调“人”，nothing but 强调“事物”。例如：Nothing but patience can cure this problem（只有耐心才能解决这个问题）。此外，none but 是 no one but 的正式变体，多用于文学或正式演讲中。

初中阶段通常只要求学生理解 only 和简单的 except 用法，例如 Only Tom can answer this question 或 Nobody except Tom can answer it。高中阶段则要求学生掌握 No one but... / Nothing but... 作主语时的主谓一致问题，并能在书面表达中主动运用该结构增强语气。同时，高中还需辨析 but 在不同语境中的词性：作介词（except）与作连词（但是）的区别。

易错点一：误把 but 当作连词，导致句子逻辑理解错误。例如 No one but Tom was late 意思是“只有汤姆迟到了”，而不是“没有人，但是汤姆迟到了”。易错点二：主谓一致错误。即使 but 后面接的是复数名词，谓语动词仍用单数，因为主语核心是 no one。易错点三：混淆 no one but 与 nothing but 的使用对象。前者用于人，后者用于事物或抽象概念。易错点四：在书面表达中过度使用该结构，导致句式单一。高中写作中应将其与 only、It is...that... 强调句等交替使用，以体现句式多样性。
forms: No one but + 名词/代词 + 单数谓语动词（强调“只有某人”）
Nothing but + 名词/代词 + 单数谓语动词（强调“只有某物/某事”）
None but + 名词/代词 + 单数谓语动词（正式/文学语体）
No one/Nothing + except + 名词/代词 + 谓语动词（与 but 可互换，语气稍弱）
Who/What + but + 名词/代词 + 谓语动词？（反问式强调）
There is no one/nothing but + 名词/代词 + 定语从句（存在句中的强调）
notes: 高考书面表达中，No one but... 作主语时谓语动词必须用单数，这是语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
but 在该结构中为介词（except），不是连词。判断方法：but 后面接代词时，若用宾格（如 but him/but me），说明 but 是介词。
no one but 强调“人”，nothing but 强调“事物或抽象概念”。写作时不要混用，例如不能说 No one but patience can solve it。
该结构语气较强，适合议论文和演讲稿。说明文或日常叙述中过度使用会显得生硬，应适当用 only、merely、solely 等替换。
none but 属于正式语域，常见于文学作品或正式演讲。高考阅读理解中遇到时，应能快速识别其等同于 only 或 no one except。

examples.en: No one but Tom can swim across this river.
examples.cn: 只有汤姆能游过这条河。

examples.en: Nothing but practice makes perfect.
examples.cn: 只有练习才能熟能生巧。

examples.en: No one except my parents knows my secret.
examples.cn: 除了我父母，没有人知道我的秘密。

examples.en: No one but the head teacher has the authority to change the school rules.
examples.cn: 只有校长才有权修改校规。

examples.en: Nothing but a strong will can carry you through the darkest moments of life.
examples.cn: 只有坚强的意志才能带你度过人生最黑暗的时刻。

examples.en: None but those who have experienced failure can truly appreciate the value of success.
examples.cn: 只有经历过失败的人才能真正体会到成功的价值。

exercises.q: ______ but Tom can help me with my English.
exercises.explain: No one but... 表示“除了……没有人”，强调只有汤姆能帮忙。

exercises.q: No one but Lily ______ the answer.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数形式。

exercises.q: ______ but my father can drive the car in my family.
exercises.explain: 表示“只有我爸爸会开车”，No one but 后接人。

exercises.q: No one but the twins ______ in the classroom now.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时，谓语动词与 No one 保持一致，用单数。

exercises.q: No one but you ______ the secret.
exercises.explain: No one but... 结构作主语时，谓语动词用单数。

exercises.q: No one but Mary ______ (like) the blue dress.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数。

exercises.q: ______ (没有人) but Jack can play the piano in our class.
exercises.explain: No one but... 表示“除了杰克没有人”。

exercises.q: No one but my parents ______ (be) at home yesterday.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，yesterday 提示用过去式。

exercises.q: No one but Tom and Jerry are in the room.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，应改为 is。

exercises.q: No one but you can help me now.
exercises.explain: No one but... 结构正确，表示“只有你能帮我”。

exercises.answer: No one but Tom can swim in our class.
exercises.explain: No one but... 可以替换 only，表示“只有”。

exercises.q: No one but Lily likes the red apple. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Does no one but Lily like the red apple?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句需借助助动词 does，谓语动词还原为原形。

exercises.q: No one but my mother can cook well. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: No one but my mother cannot cook well.
exercises.explain: 在情态动词 can 后加 not 构成否定。

exercises.q: No one but the students are in the library.
exercises.answer: No one but the students is in the library.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，are 应改为 is。

exercises.q: No one but I are good at math.
exercises.answer: No one but I am good at math.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，are 应改为 am。

exercises.q: No one but the teacher ______ allowed to enter the office.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数。

exercises.q: ______ but Lucy and Lily can solve this problem.
exercises.explain: No one but... 表示“除了露西和莉莉没有人能解决”。

exercises.q: No one but my brother ______ how to fix the computer.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数。

exercises.q: No one but the doctors ______ allowed to enter the room yesterday.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，yesterday 提示用过去式。

exercises.q: No one but Jim and I ______ going to the party.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词与 No one 一致，用单数 is。

exercises.q: No one but the manager ______ (have) the key to the office.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数。

exercises.q: ______ (没有人) but my sister can speak French in my family.
exercises.explain: No one but... 表示“除了我姐姐没有人会说法语”。

exercises.q: No one but the twins ______ (be) late for school this morning.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，this morning 提示用过去式。

exercises.q: No one but the students were in the classroom.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，were 应改为 was。

exercises.q: No one but you has the ability to finish the task.
exercises.explain: No one but... 结构正确，谓语动词用单数 has。

exercises.q: Only the headmaster can open this door. (用 No one but 改写)
exercises.answer: No one but the headmaster can open this door.
exercises.explain: No one but... 可以替换 only，表示“只有”。

exercises.q: No one but Tom was late for school. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Was no one but Tom late for school?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 be 动词 was 提到句首。

exercises.answer: No one but my father is able to repair the bike.
exercises.explain: can 可以替换为 be able to，注意人称和数的一致。

exercises.q: No one but the teachers have the right to use this room.
exercises.answer: No one but the teachers has the right to use this room.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，have 应改为 has。

exercises.q: No one but I are responsible for the accident.
exercises.answer: No one but I am responsible for the accident.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，are 应改为 am。

exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，who 引导的定语从句不影响主句谓语。

exercises.q: ______ but the brave firefighter dared to enter the burning building.
exercises.explain: No one but... 表示“除了勇敢的消防员没有人敢进入”。

exercises.q: No one but the members of the committee ______ the right to vote.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，与 No one 保持一致。

exercises.q: No one but those who have passed the exam ______ allowed to attend the advanced course.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，those who 引导的定语从句不影响主谓一致。

exercises.q: No one but the experienced teacher ______ how to handle such a difficult situation.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数。

exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，定语从句不影响主谓一致。

exercises.q: ______ (没有人) but the captain can decide whether to change the route.
exercises.explain: No one but... 表示“除了船长没有人能决定”。

exercises.q: No one but the witnesses who were present at the scene ______ (be) able to describe what happened.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，过去时用 was。

exercises.q: No one but the students who have finished their homework are allowed to leave.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，are 应改为 is。

exercises.q: No one but the manager has the authority to sign the contract.
exercises.explain: No one but... 结构正确，谓语动词用单数 has。

exercises.q: Only the committee members can make the final decision. (用 No one but 改写)
exercises.answer: No one but the committee members can make the final decision.
exercises.explain: No one but... 可以替换 only，表示“只有”。

exercises.q: No one but the principal was informed of the changes. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Was no one but the principal informed of the changes?
exercises.explain: 一般疑问句将 be 动词 was 提到句首。

exercises.q: No one but the experienced pilot could land the plane safely. (用 be able to 改写)
exercises.answer: No one but the experienced pilot was able to land the plane safely.
exercises.explain: could 可以替换为 was able to，表示过去的能力。

exercises.q: No one but the scientists who conducted the experiment have access to the data.
exercises.answer: No one but the scientists who conducted the experiment has access to the data.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，have 应改为 has。

exercises.q: No one but the members of the board are responsible for the financial loss.
exercises.answer: No one but the members of the board is responsible for the financial loss.
exercises.explain: No one but... 作主语时谓语动词用单数，are 应改为 is。

exercises.q: No one but Tom and Jerry ______ invited to the party yesterday.
exercises.explain: “No one but...”作主语时谓语用单数，且时间状语是 yesterday，用一般过去时。

exercises.q: ______ but Lucy knows the secret code to the lab.
exercises.explain: 根据句意“只有 Lucy 知道密码”，应选 No one but 表示“除了……没有人”。

exercises.q: No one but my parents ______ me when I was in trouble.
exercises.explain: 主语是 No one but my parents，谓语用单数，且从句为过去时，主句也用过去时。

exercises.q: The word “but” in “No one but you” means ______.
exercises.explain: 在“No one but you”中，but 是介词，意为“除了”。

exercises.q: No one but Lily ______ able to answer the difficult question last class.
exercises.explain: 主语为单数，且时间 last class 表明用一般过去时。

exercises.q: No one but Jack ______ (like) playing chess in our class.
exercises.explain: “No one but...”作主语时谓语动词用单数形式。

exercises.q: ______ but the teacher can open this door.
exercises.explain: 句意“只有老师能打开这扇门”，用 No one but 表示强调。

exercises.q: No one but my sister ______ (be) at home when I called.
exercises.explain: 主语为单数，时间状语 when I called 表明用一般过去时。

exercises.q: No one but the students were in the classroom after school.
exercises.explain: “No one but...”作主语时谓语动词应用单数，were 应改为 was。

exercises.q: No one but my mother knows my favorite food.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but my mother 为单数，谓语 knows 使用正确。

exercises.q: Only Tom can finish the task. (用 No one but 改写)
exercises.answer: No one but Tom can finish the task.
exercises.explain: Only + 名词可转换为 No one but + 名词，表示“只有”。

exercises.q: No one but Mary likes the blue dress. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Does anyone but Mary like the blue dress?
exercises.explain: 将 No one but 改为 anyone but，并借助助动词 Does 构成疑问句。

exercises.q: No one but Jim can speak French in our group. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: No one but Jim cannot speak French in our group.
exercises.explain: 在情态动词 can 后加 not 构成否定，注意主语仍为单数。

exercises.q: No one but the boys were playing football on the playground.
exercises.answer: No one but the boys was playing football on the playground.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the boys 为单数，谓语应用 was 而非 were。

exercises.q: No one but I are responsible for the broken window.
exercises.answer: No one but I am responsible for the broken window.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but I 的中心词是 No one，谓语用 am 与 I 保持一致。

exercises.q: No one but the headmaster ______ the final decision on this matter.
exercises.explain: “No one but...”作主语时谓语用单数，且此处表示一般事实。

exercises.q: ______ but the most experienced climbers can reach the top of that mountain.
exercises.explain: No one but 表示“只有”，强调只有最有经验的登山者才能登顶。

exercises.q: No one but you ______ the truth about what happened that night.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but you 为单数，谓语用 knows，表示一般现在时。

exercises.q: No one but the manager ______ to sign the contract.
exercises.explain: 主语为单数，且此处表示“被允许”，用被动语态 is allowed。

exercises.q: No one but the twins ______ the answer to the riddle, which surprised the teacher.
exercises.explain: 主句用一般过去时，且主语 No one but the twins 为单数，谓语用 knew。

exercises.q: No one but the volunteers ______ (be) willing to clean the park last weekend.
exercises.explain: 主语为单数，时间状语 last weekend 表明用一般过去时。

exercises.q: No one but the captain ______ (have) the key to the equipment room.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the captain 为单数，谓语用 has。

exercises.q: ______ but the best students can enter that advanced class.
exercises.explain: No one but 表示“只有”，强调只有最好的学生才能进入那个高级班。

exercises.q: No one but the teachers have access to the library database.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the teachers 为单数，谓语应用 has 而非 have。

exercises.q: No one but the principal was informed of the school's new policy.
exercises.explain: 主语为单数，谓语 was informed 使用正确。

exercises.q: Only the manager can approve this budget. (用 No one but 改写)
exercises.answer: No one but the manager can approve this budget.
exercises.explain: Only + 名词可转换为 No one but + 名词，表示“只有”。

exercises.q: No one but the coach knows the training plan. (改为一般疑问句)
exercises.answer: Does anyone but the coach know the training plan?
exercises.explain: 将 No one but 改为 anyone but，并借助助动词 Does 构成疑问句。

exercises.q: No one but the team leader can make the final call. (改为否定句)
exercises.answer: No one but the team leader cannot make the final call.
exercises.explain: 在情态动词 can 后加 not 构成否定，主语仍为单数。

exercises.q: No one but the committee members were present at the meeting.
exercises.answer: No one but the committee members was present at the meeting.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the committee members 为单数，谓语应用 was。

exercises.q: No one but the scientists have discovered the new species in the rainforest.
exercises.answer: No one but the scientists has discovered the new species in the rainforest.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the scientists 为单数，谓语应用 has。

exercises.q: No one but the lead researcher ______ access to the classified data, which has been strictly protected.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the lead researcher 为单数，谓语用 has，且非谓语动词 having/to have 不能作谓语。

exercises.q: ______ but the most dedicated students can complete the advanced physics project within a week.
exercises.explain: No one but 表示“只有”，强调只有最专注的学生才能在一周内完成高级物理项目。

exercises.q: No one but the committee ______ the authority to overturn the previous decision.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the committee 为单数，谓语用 has，表示拥有权力。

exercises.q: No one but the witness ______ the exact sequence of events that led to the accident.
exercises.explain: 主语为单数，情态动词 can 后接动词原形 recall。

exercises.q: No one but the editor-in-chief ______ the final version of the article before it goes to print.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the editor-in-chief 为单数，谓语用 approves。

exercises.q: No one but the board members ______ (be) entitled to vote on the merger proposal.
exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the board members 为单数，谓语用 is。

exercises.q: No one but the principal ______ (have) the authority to suspend a student for such a serious offense.
exercises.explain: 主语为单数，谓语用 has，表示拥有权力。

exercises.explain: No one but 表示“只有”，强调只有最熟练的谈判者才能解决如此复杂的国际争端。

exercises.explain: 主语 No one but the researchers 为单数，谓语应用 has 而非 have。

grammar.titleEn: Partial Inversion after “Only by / Only + Adverbial” (including only when, only if, only then, etc.)
grammar.usage:
本语法点核心结构为“Only + 状语（介词短语、副词、状语从句等）”置于句首时，主句需要部分倒装，即把助动词、情态动词或 be 动词提到主语之前。最常见的形式是“Only by + doing sth + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 谓语动词原形”，用来强调“只有通过某种方式、条件或时间，才能实现某一结果”。

肯定句结构为：Only by doing A + can/will/do/does/did + 主语 + 动词原形。例如：Only by practising daily can you improve your spoken English. 否定句通常体现在主句动词部分，如：Only by taking risks will you not remain ordinary. 疑问句较少直接使用该结构，但在正式书面语或修辞性问句中可见：Only by trying can we know the result? 更常见的是在陈述句中使用倒装表达强调。

与近义结构对比：普通语序“You can gain insight only by understanding your thoughts”语气平淡，而“Only by understanding your thoughts can you gain insight”将条件前置并倒装，语气更强，常用于议论文、演讲稿和正式书面表达。注意“Only + 主语”不倒装，例如“Only you can help me”，因为 only 修饰的是主语而非状语。

初中阶段通常只接触“only”表示“仅仅”的普通用法，如“Only Tom likes math.”，较少涉及句首倒装。高中阶段则要求掌握“Only + 状语”位于句首时的部分倒装，并能区分 only 修饰状语与修饰主语的不同，同时能在书面表达中主动运用该结构提升句式多样性。

易错点：1）忘记倒装，把“Only by working hard you can succeed”写成正常语序，这是最常见的错误；2）倒装过度，把实义动词直接提前，如“Only by working hard can you succeed”不能写成“Only by working hard succeed you”；3）混淆 only 修饰成分，当 only 修饰主语时不能倒装；4）时态混乱，倒装后助动词要体现原句时态，如过去时用 did，完成时用 has/have/had。
forms: Only by + doing sth + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 动词原形
Only + 介词短语 + 助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 动词原形
Only + 副词（then/later/now）+ 助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 动词原形
Only + when/if/after 引导的状语从句 + 主句部分倒装
Only + 主语 + 谓语（不倒装）
Only by + doing sth + did/does/do + 主语 + 动词原形（根据时态选择助动词）
notes: 高考书面表达中，使用“Only by doing...”开头时，主句必须倒装，否则视为语法错误，影响句式得分。
注意区分 only 修饰状语与修饰主语：Only in this way can we win（倒装）vs Only he knows the truth（不倒装）。
倒装时只需把助动词、情态动词或 be 动词提前，实义动词仍留在主语之后，不能把实义动词直接提到主语前。
在正式语域中，“Only when/if/after + 从句”置于句首时，倒装发生在主句，不在从句，例如：Only when the rain stopped did they leave.
高考语法填空和短文改错中常考“Only + 状语”句首后主句语序，注意时态和助动词的选择，如过去时用 did，现在完成时用 has/have。

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语
grammar.title: 动名词作主语：从基础用法到高中拓展（含不定式对比与形式主语）
grammar.titleEn: Gerund as Subject: Core Usage, Gerund vs Infinitive, and Formal Subject Patterns
grammar.usage:
动名词由“动词原形 + -ing”构成，在句中起名词作用。当动名词或动名词短语位于句首充当主语时，表示一种泛指性、习惯性或抽象性的活动、行为或状态。核心结构为：Gerund/ Gerund Phrase + 单数谓语动词。由于动名词短语作主语时被视作一个整体概念，谓语动词一律用单数形式，例如 is, was, has, does 等。肯定句直接以动名词短语开头；否定句在动名词前加 not，构成“Not + doing sth. + 谓语”结构；疑问句则借助 it 作形式主语，构成“Is it worth doing...?”、“Does doing... make sense?”等句式，或将动名词短语置于助动词之后进行提问。

在初中阶段，动名词作主语主要出现在简单句中，如“Swimming is fun.”，强调某项活动本身。高中阶段则更常见“动名词短语 + 系动词 + 表语从句/形容词/名词”的复杂结构，且常与不定式作主语形成对比。动名词作主语多表示一般性、习惯性或已知事实，而不定式作主语往往表示具体的、一次性的或将来的动作。例如“Reading widely helps you write better.”强调普遍经验，而“To read this novel tonight is my plan.”则指向具体安排。

高中还需掌握“It + be + 名词/形容词 + 动名词短语”的形式主语结构，如“It is no use crying over spilt milk.”和“It is worth making an effort.”。这类结构中，真正的主语是后面的动名词短语，it 只是形式主语。常见搭配有：It is no use/no good doing sth., It is worth doing sth., It is a waste of time doing sth. 等。

易错点一：动名词作主语与现在分词作表语或定语混淆。动名词具有名词性，可作主语、宾语；现在分词具有形容词或副词性，常构成进行时态或作定语、状语。例如“Reading is important.”中的 Reading 是动名词作主语，而“He is reading.”中的 reading 是现在分词，构成进行时。

易错点二：动名词短语作主语时，谓语动词的单复数判断。无论动名词短语中包含多少名词或代词，整个短语仍视为单数，谓语动词用单数。例如“Knowing your strengths and weaknesses is essential.”中，主语是“Knowing your strengths and weaknesses”这一整体，谓语用 is。

易错点三：否定形式的位置。动名词的否定形式是“not + doing”，而不是“don't + doing”或“doing not”。例如“Not asking for help is a common mistake.”。

易错点四：动名词与不定式作主语时的语义差异。动名词侧重已知事实或一般经验，不定式侧重未发生或假设性的具体行为。在“It is important to learn English.”与“Learning English is important.”中，前者更强调具体行动的必要性，后者更强调学习英语这件事本身的重要性。
forms: Gerund + 单数谓语动词：Doing sth. + V(单数) + ...
否定形式：Not + doing sth. + V(单数) + ...
形式主语结构：It + be + no use/no good/worth + doing sth.
动名词短语作主语：Doing A and doing B + V(单数) + ...
疑问形式：Does doing sth. + 动词原形 + ...? / Is it worth doing sth.?
notes: 动名词短语作主语时，无论短语多长、包含多少并列成分，谓语动词一律用单数，这是高考语法填空和短文改错的高频考点。
“Not doing sth.”是否定动名词的正确形式，不要写成“Don't doing sth.”或“Doing not sth.”。
在书面语中，动名词作主语比不定式作主语更正式、更抽象，适合议论文和说明文；不定式作主语则更侧重具体动作或目的。
注意区分“It is no use doing sth.”与“It is no use to do sth.”：前者是标准用法，后者在高考书面表达中应避免。
动名词作主语与现在分词作状语或定语在形式上相同，但句法功能完全不同。判断标准：动名词可被形容词性物主代词或名词所有格修饰，如“His coming late surprised us.”。

grammar.key: Modal Verb for Advice/Suggestion: 'have to' vs. 'should' / 表建议的情态动词：'have to' 与 'should'
grammar.title: 表建议的情态动词：have to 与 should（兼及 must / ought to / need to）
grammar.titleEn: Modal Verbs for Advice and Obligation: have to vs. should (with must, ought to, need to)
grammar.usage:
“have to”和“should”都可以用来提出建议，但语气和来源不同。“have to”表示强烈的必要性或义务，通常来自外部规则、客观情况或逻辑上的必然要求，说话人往往在强调“如果不这样做，就会有不良后果”。它的核心结构是“主语 + have/has to + 动词原形”，否定形式为“主语 + don't/doesn't/didn't have to + 动词原形”，疑问形式为“Do/Does/Did + 主语 + have to + 动词原形？”。在提出建议时，“have to”比“should”更紧迫，几乎等同于“必须”，但比“must”更口语化、更常用。

与“have to”相比，“should”表示较为温和的建议，通常来自说话人的主观看法、道德判断或一般经验，语气上留有选择余地。“ought to”与“should”意思接近，但在书面语中略显正式。“must”表示说话人主观认定的强烈义务或规则，语气最强，常用于正式规定或强烈警告。高中阶段需要进一步区分：在表达“必要性”时，“have to”更侧重外部原因，而“must”更侧重说话人内心的判断；在否定句中，“don't have to”表示“不必、没有必要”，而“mustn't”表示“禁止、不准”，两者含义完全不同。

初中阶段主要掌握“have to”的基本形式变化和“should + 动词原形”的简单建议用法；高中阶段则要求在写作和阅读中准确区分“have to / must / should / ought to / need to”的语气差异，并能在不同语域中灵活使用。例如，在议论文或建议信中，连续使用“should”会显得语气单一，适当穿插“have to”或“need to”可以增强说服力。

易错点一：混淆“don't have to”和“mustn't”。“You don't have to finish it today”表示“你今天不必完成”，而“You mustn't finish it today”表示“你今天不准完成”，意思相反。易错点二：把“have to”当成普通实义动词，忘记在疑问句和否定句中借助助动词 do/does/did。易错点三：在表达过去义务时，误用“should”代替“had to”。“should have done”表示“本应做而未做”，与“had to do”表示“当时不得不做”不同。易错点四：在正式书面语中过度使用“have to”表达主观建议，忽略了“ought to”和“should”在语域上的差异。
forms: 肯定：主语 + have/has to + 动词原形（You have to notice the signs.）
否定：主语 + don't/doesn't/didn't have to + 动词原形（You don't have to come.）
疑问：Do/Does/Did + 主语 + have to + 动词原形？（Do I have to go now?）
建议：主语 + should/ought to + 动词原形（You should talk to your teacher.）
过去义务：主语 + had to + 动词原形（We had to wait outside.）
过去建议（未实现）：主语 + should have + 过去分词（You should have told me earlier.）
notes: 高考书面表达中，表达强烈建议时用“have to”比“should”更能体现紧迫感，但不要通篇只用一种情态动词，应根据语境交替使用 should / need to / ought to。
“don't have to”表示“不必”，而“mustn't”表示“禁止”，高考语法填空和完形填空常在此处设陷阱。
在正式书面语或议论文中，表达客观必要性时优先用“have to”或“need to”，表达主观建议时用“should”或“ought to”，避免语域混乱。
“have to”有人称和时态变化（has to / had to / will have to），而“should”没有，写作时注意主谓一致。
“should have done”表示对过去的遗憾或批评，与“had to do”表示的过去实际义务完全不同，阅读理解中要结合上下文判断。

examples.en: You have to wear a helmet when you ride a bike.
examples.cn: 你骑自行车时必须戴头盔。

examples.en: Do we have to hand in the homework tomorrow?
examples.cn: 我们明天必须交作业吗？

examples.en: You don't have to come if you are busy, but you should call me first.
examples.cn: 如果你忙就不必来，但你应该先给我打个电话。

examples.en: We had to cancel the match because of the heavy rain.
examples.cn: 由于大雨，我们不得不取消比赛。

examples.en: You ought to apologize to her, and you have to mean it this time.
examples.cn: 你应该向她道歉，而且这一次你必须是真心的。

examples.en: In academic writing, one has to distinguish between personal opinion and evidence-based argument.
examples.cn: 在学术写作中，人们必须区分个人观点与基于证据的论证。

exercises.q: You ______ finish your homework before you watch TV.
exercises.explain: 主语是 you，用 have to 表示“必须”。

exercises.q: She ______ get up early tomorrow morning.
exercises.explain: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，用 has to。

exercises.q: You look tired. You ______ go to bed early.
exercises.explain: 表示温和建议用 should，不是强制义务。

exercises.q: We ______ wear a uniform at school. It's a rule.
exercises.explain: 学校规定属于外部义务，用 have to。

exercises.q: You ______ worry. The test is easy.
exercises.explain: don't have to 表示“没有必要”。

exercises.q: My brother ______ to clean his room every Saturday.
exercises.explain: 主语 my brother 是第三人称单数，用 has to。

exercises.q: You ______ to drink more water every day.
exercises.explain: 主语是 you，用 have to。

exercises.q: We ______ to be quiet in the library.
exercises.explain: 主语 we 是复数，用 have to。

exercises.q: The sentence "She have to go now" is correct.
exercises.explain: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，应用 has to。

exercises.q: The sentence "You don't have to come if you are busy" means it is not necessary to come.
exercises.explain: don't have to 表示“没有必要”。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in negative form: I have to go now.
exercises.answer: I don't have to go now.
exercises.explain: have to 的否定形式是 don't have to。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence as a question: You have to wear a hat.
exercises.answer: Do you have to wear a hat?
exercises.explain: have to 的一般疑问句用 Do 开头。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "has to": My father must leave at 7.
exercises.answer: My father has to leave at 7.
exercises.explain: must 表义务时可转换为 has to。

exercises.q: He have to do his homework now.
exercises.answer: He has to do his homework now.
exercises.explain: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，应用 has to。

exercises.q: You should to eat more vegetables.
exercises.explain: should 后直接跟动词原形，不加 to。

exercises.q: You ______ smoke here. It's against the rules.
exercises.explain: mustn't 表示“禁止”，语气比 don't have to 强。

exercises.q: I missed the bus, so I ______ walk to school yesterday.
exercises.explain: 过去时用 had to 表示“不得不”。

exercises.q: You ______ bring food. We already have plenty.
exercises.explain: don't have to 表示“没有必要”。

exercises.q: If you feel sick, you ______ see a doctor.
exercises.explain: 表示建议用 should，语气比 have to 弱。

exercises.q: Students ______ be late for class. The teacher is very strict.
exercises.explain: mustn't 表示“禁止”，符合严格规定。

exercises.q: Last night I ______ to finish my project before midnight.
exercises.explain: 过去时用 had to 表示“不得不”。

exercises.q: You ______ to be careful when you cross the road.
exercises.explain: 主语 you 用 have to 表示“必须”。

exercises.q: She ______ to take medicine three times a day.
exercises.explain: 主语 she 是第三人称单数，用 has to。

exercises.q: The sentence "You mustn't to park here" is correct.
exercises.explain: mustn't 后直接跟动词原形，不加 to。

exercises.q: The sentence "He had to stay at home because it rained" means he chose to stay at home.
exercises.explain: had to 表示“不得不”，不是自愿选择。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence in the past tense: I have to clean my room.
exercises.answer: I had to clean my room.
exercises.explain: have to 的过去式是 had to。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "don't have to": It is not necessary for you to come early.
exercises.answer: You don't have to come early.
exercises.explain: not necessary 可转换为 don't have to。

exercises.q: Rewrite as a question: She has to wear glasses.
exercises.answer: Does she have to wear glasses?
exercises.explain: 第三人称单数疑问句用 Does 开头，动词还原。

exercises.q: You haven't to bring your own towel.
exercises.answer: You don't have to bring your own towel.
exercises.explain: have to 的否定形式是 don't have to，不是 haven't to。

exercises.q: She musts finish her work today.
exercises.answer: She must finish her work today.
exercises.explain: must 是情态动词，没有人称和数的变化。

exercises.q: You ______ have told me earlier. Now it's too late.
exercises.explain: should have done 表示“本应该做而未做”。

exercises.q: By the time we arrived, the meeting ______ already started, so we had to wait outside.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时用 had already started。

exercises.q: You ______ worry about the exam. You've prepared well.
exercises.explain: don't have to 表示“没有必要”。

exercises.q: If you want to succeed, you ______ be willing to work hard.
exercises.explain: have to 表示强烈的必要性。

exercises.q: He ______ be at home now. His car is in the driveway.
exercises.explain: must 表示有根据的推测。

exercises.q: You ______ have been more careful when you were driving.
exercises.explain: should have been 表示“本应该更小心”。

exercises.q: She ______ to submit the report by Friday, or she will miss the deadline.
exercises.explain: 主语 she 用 has to 表示“必须”。

exercises.q: We ______ have taken the earlier train. Now we are stuck in traffic.
exercises.explain: should have taken 表示“本应该搭乘”。

exercises.q: The sentence "You shouldn't have lied to her" means you lied to her and it was a mistake.
exercises.explain: shouldn't have done 表示“本不应该做却做了”。

exercises.q: The sentence "He mustn't have finished the work" expresses a logical conclusion about the past.
exercises.explain: 对过去的推测用 must have done，否定用 can't have done。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "should have": It was a mistake for you to ignore her advice.
exercises.answer: You should have listened to her advice.
exercises.explain: should have done 表示“本应该做而未做”。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "don't have to": It is unnecessary for you to bring your own laptop.
exercises.answer: You don't have to bring your own laptop.
exercises.explain: unnecessary 可转换为 don't have to。

exercises.q: Rewrite using "must have": I am sure she was very tired after the long journey.
exercises.answer: She must have been very tired after the long journey.
exercises.explain: must have been 表示对过去的肯定推测。

exercises.q: You should have not gone there alone at night.
exercises.answer: You should not have gone there alone at night.
exercises.explain: should not have done 中 not 应放在 should 之后。

exercises.q: He must has finished his homework by now.
exercises.answer: He must have finished his homework by now.
exercises.explain: must have done 中 have 用原形，不用 has。

exercises.q: You ______ finish your homework before you can play video games. That's the rule in my house.
exercises.explain: 句中的“That's the rule”表明是外部规则，用 have to 表示必须。

exercises.q: I think you ______ drink more water every day. It's good for your health.
exercises.explain: 表示温和的建议，用 should 最合适。

exercises.q: She ______ wear a uniform at work. The company requires it.
exercises.explain: 公司规定属于外部要求，主语是 she，用 has to。

exercises.q: You ______ worry about the test. You have studied very hard.
exercises.explain: don't have to 表示“没有必要”，符合语境。

exercises.q: We ______ be late for the meeting. The manager hates waiting.
exercises.explain: mustn't 表示强烈的禁止，意为“绝不能”。

exercises.q: My brother ______ (have to) take the bus to school because our car is broken.
exercises.explain: 主语 my brother 是第三人称单数，用 has to。

exercises.q: You ______ (not have to) bring any food. We will order pizza.
exercises.explain: 表示没有必要带食物，用 don't have to。

exercises.q: I think you ______ (should) apologize to her. You were rude.
exercises.explain: 表示建议，用 should。

exercises.q: The sentence "You have to notice the status of being negative" means noticing the negative status is a strong necessity.
exercises.explain: have to 表示强烈的必要性，所以该理解正确。

exercises.q: "You don't have to come" means you are not allowed to come.
exercises.explain: don't have to 表示“不必”，不是“禁止”。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "have to": It is necessary for us to wear school uniforms.
exercises.answer: We have to wear school uniforms.
exercises.explain: 用 have to 表达外部规定的必要性。

exercises.q: Change the sentence into negative: She has to clean her room every day.
exercises.answer: She doesn't have to clean her room every day.
exercises.explain: have to 的否定形式是 doesn't have to。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "should": It is a good idea for you to sleep earlier.
exercises.explain: should 用于提出建议。

exercises.q: He don't have to go to school on Sunday.
exercises.answer: He doesn't have to go to school on Sunday.
exercises.explain: 主语 he 是第三人称单数，否定形式用 doesn't have to。

exercises.q: You should to listen to your parents.
exercises.answer: You should listen to your parents.
exercises.explain: should 后直接跟动词原形，不加 to。

exercises.q: When I was young, I ______ walk to school every day because there was no bus.
exercises.explain: 过去的外部条件迫使，用 had to 表示过去的必须。

exercises.q: You ______ be exhausted after working for twelve hours without a break.
exercises.explain: must 在此表示很有把握的推测，意为“一定”。

exercises.q: The sign says all visitors ______ show their ID cards at the entrance.
exercises.explain: 规定要求属于外部义务，用 have to。

exercises.q: You ______ smoke here. It's a non-smoking area.
exercises.explain: mustn't 表示强烈禁止，符合禁烟区的规定。

exercises.q: If you want to improve your English, you ______ practice speaking every day.
exercises.explain: 提出改进英语的建议，用 should 表示温和建议。

exercises.q: Last night I ______ (have to) stay up late to finish my project.
exercises.explain: last night 表明过去时间，用 had to。

exercises.q: You ______ (not should) eat so much junk food. It's bad for you.
exercises.explain: should 的否定形式是 shouldn't，表示“不应该”。

exercises.q: Employees ______ (have to) attend the meeting every Monday. It's company policy.
exercises.explain: 公司政策是外部规定，主语是复数，用 have to。

exercises.q: "You mustn't tell anyone" has the same meaning as "You don't have to tell anyone."
exercises.explain: mustn't 表示禁止，don't have to 表示不必要，两者含义不同。

exercises.q: In the sentence "You have to notice the status of being negative", "have to" can be replaced by "must" without changing the basic meaning of strong necessity.
exercises.explain: have to 和 must 都可表示强烈的必要性，此处可互换。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "be able to": She can solve this math problem.
exercises.answer: She is able to solve this math problem.
exercises.explain: can 与 be able to 可互换表示能力。

exercises.q: Change the sentence into a question: You have to submit the form by Friday.
exercises.answer: Do you have to submit the form by Friday?
exercises.explain: have to 的疑问句需要借助助动词 do。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "had to": It was necessary for him to leave early.
exercises.explain: 过去的必要性用 had to 表达。

exercises.q: You haven't to bring your laptop if you don't want to.
exercises.answer: You don't have to bring your laptop if you don't want to.
exercises.explain: have to 的否定形式是 don't have to，不是 haven't to。

exercises.q: She shoulds see a doctor about her headache.
exercises.answer: She should see a doctor about her headache.
exercises.explain: should 是情态动词，没有第三人称单数变化。

exercises.q: By the time the rescue team arrived, the trapped miners ______ without food for nearly three days.
exercises.explain: 过去完成时表示在过去某一时间之前已经完成的动作，had had to 是 have to 的过去完成形式。

exercises.q: Given the severity of the situation, the committee insisted that every member ______ the new safety protocols without exception.
exercises.explain: insist 后的 that 从句用虚拟语气，should + 动词原形，should 可省略。

exercises.q: You ______ have told him the truth; he wasn't ready to handle it, and now he's devastated.
exercises.explain: shouldn't have done 表示对过去行为的责备，意为“本不应该做”。

exercises.q: The new policy stipulates that all employees ______ complete the online training module before accessing the database.
exercises.explain: 政策规定属于外部强制要求，用 have to 表示必须。

exercises.q: If you had listened to my advice, you ______ in this predicament now.
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气混合条件句，过去条件导致现在结果，用 wouldn't be。

exercises.q: The doctor recommended that he ______ (have to) reduce his sugar intake immediately.
exercises.explain: recommend 后的 that 从句用虚拟语气，should + 动词原形。

exercises.q: Not until he received the final warning ______ (he realize) that he had to change his attitude.
exercises.explain: Not until 置于句首引起部分倒装，用 did he realize。

exercises.q: It is essential that every participant ______ (have to) sign the consent form before the experiment begins.
exercises.explain: It is essential that 后的从句用虚拟语气，should + 动词原形。

exercises.q: The sentence "You have to notice the status of being negative" implies that noticing the negative status is optional if you feel comfortable.
exercises.explain: have to 表示强烈的必要性，不是可选项。

exercises.q: "He must have forgotten the meeting" expresses a logical deduction about a past event.
exercises.explain: must have done 表示对过去事件很有把握的推测。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "be obliged to": All visitors have to register at the front desk.
exercises.answer: All visitors are obliged to register at the front desk.
exercises.explain: be obliged to 与 have to 都表示外部强制的义务。

exercises.q: Rewrite the sentence using "should have": It was a mistake for you to ignore her warning.
exercises.answer: You should have listened to her warning.
exercises.explain: should have done 表示过去本应该做而未做。

exercises.q: Change the sentence into a negative question: You have to pay a deposit before moving in.
exercises.answer: Don't you have to pay a deposit before moving in?
exercises.explain: have to 的否定疑问句用 Don't you have to... 结构。

exercises.q: Had he not been warned by his colleagues, he would have to face the consequences alone.
exercises.answer: Had he not been warned by his colleagues, he would have had to face the consequences alone.
exercises.explain: 虚拟语气过去时，主句需用 would have had to 表示过去本不得不。

exercises.q: The regulations require that each applicant has to submit two letters of recommendation.
exercises.answer: The regulations require that each applicant should submit two letters of recommendation.
exercises.explain: require 后的 that 从句用虚拟语气，should + 动词原形，不用 has to。
